Implemented the iterator-helper fix.

- Generator iterators now inherit from `Iterator.prototype` when available, exposing `take`, `flatMap`, `map`, etc.
- Older Node.js runtimes retain the existing plain-object fallback.
- Added regression coverage for prototype inheritance, self-iteration, and `take().toArray()`.

Changed [iterator.rs](/private/tmp/luban-agent-benchmark-work/repos/napi-rs__napi-rs-2784/codex/crates/napi/src/bindgen_runtime/iterator.rs) and [generator.spec.ts](/private/tmp/luban-agent-benchmark-work/repos/napi-rs__napi-rs-2784/codex/examples/napi/__tests__/generator.spec.ts).

Validation passed: `cargo fmt --check`, `git diff --check`, and a Node iterator-helper smoke test. Full Cargo checking was blocked by the uncached `convert_case` dependency while offline.
